notes.title: Announcement of MR.ELEVATOR Demo Release
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! 
We are excited to announce that the demo version of "MR.ELEVATOR" will be available starting June 10th during Steam Next Fest. 
In this version, you will be able to enjoy one specially prepared stage.

This game allows you to freely walk around and explore the world of this nostalgic Flash game-like game in a 3D space. Although the content is minimal, we hope you will fully enjoy the atmosphere of the game.

Request for Feedback
After playing the demo, please share your feedback with us. We will reflect your feedback in future.

Development is still ongoing, but we are working hard towards the official release. Please look forward to further updates!

We look forward to your play!
